about: Counts from the FIA's decision-document pages for the 2025 and 2026 Formula 1 seasons, listed on 21 Oct 2026 (2026 up to the Singapore Grand Prix, 11 Oct). Counted by the first word of each title, so 'infringement' also includes deleted-lap-time notices.
notes: The 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix documents are filed as '2026 Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia'.
Max Verstappen is Car 1 in 2025 documents and Car 3 in 2026 documents, so the points clock is keyed on the driver's name, not the number.
Some PDFs sit at addresses ending in _0.pdf (for example 2026 Hungarian Grand Prix, Doc 19), the sign of a file uploaded again under the same name.
